_README: Read-and-verify tier for sovereign 10Y yields. UNLIKE the other *-data.json
dumps this file is COMMITTED, not gitignored: no script can regenerate it.
It is written by Claude during the weekly refresh for the countries that have
no free machine-readable daily feed (see fetch-bonds.mjs header for why).
Each entry needs a `source` actually read this run and a `crossCheck` from a
DIFFERENT provider. validate-bonds.mjs rejects the run if the two disagree by
more than 25bp, if asOf is stale, or if a value is implausible. Never copy a
value forward without re-reading it -- a stale number here is worse than the
monthly FRED fallback, because this tier overrides it and claims to be daily.
Only the headline `value` comes from here. The 36-point sparkline stays on the
lagging FRED monthly series for context. Exact 1D/1M/1Y moves are unavailable
for these rows, so the table renders dashes instead of mislabelled periods.
